drivers.title: How drivers are delivered
text: The drivers for {bundled} come with the Mac app. Other drivers download as signed plugins the first time you choose the database, which needs an internet connection.
TablePro checks each plugin’s SHA-256 checksum and code signature before installing it. Plugins update separately from the app, and the iPhone and iPad app has its drivers built in.
